d: Long, flowing honey-blonde hair with straight bangs and a side part frames a youthful face with sharp, almond-shaped crimson eyes. The slender build is dressed in a white, black, and light-blue dress featuring a high-waisted pleated skirt with graphic prints, paired with long black sleek boots and asymmetrical arm sleeves. Signature details include a black choker with a gold pendant, a thin gold chain crossing the chest, and a long black polearm held in the right hand.
